content: धी €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> (धीयते) .²1 To disregard, disrespect. .²2 To propitiate. .²3 To hold, contain. .²4 To accomplish, fulfil.

धीः [ध्यै भावे क्विप् संप्रसारणं च] .²1 .³({%a%}) Intellect, understanding; धियः समग्रैः स गुणैरुदारधीः <ls>R. 3. 30</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> कुधी, सुधी <ab>&c.</ab> धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् <ls>Gāyatrīmantra</ls>; तत्राज्ञानं धिया नश्येदाभासात्तु घटः स्फुरेत् <ls>Vedāntasāra.</ls> .³({%b%}) Mind; दुष्टधी wicked-minded; स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत <ls>Bg. 2. 54</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 30</ls>. .²2 Idea, imagination, fancy, conception; न धियां पथि वर्तसे <ls>Ku. 6. 22</ls>; ध्यायन्ति चान्यं धिया <ls>Pt. 136</ls>. .²3 A thought, intention, purpose, propensity; इमामहं वेद न तावकीं धियम् <ls>Ki. 1. 37</ls>. .²4 Devotion, prayer. .²5 A sacrifice. .²6 Knowledge, science. .²7 (in Horoscope) The fifth house from the लग्न.
